title: College Board Introduces Microtransactions for 2026 Testing Season
author: Richard Kiselev
description: The College Board is adding microtransactions to the SAT, PSAT, and AP exams.
content:
Election Day Edition | November 5th, 2025 | Issue #1

The College Board, known for producing, distributing, and managing the SAT, PSAT, and AP exams, has announced that they will be phasing in microtransactions for the 2026 “Testing Season”.

“We brought in more than a billion dollars last year, but to tell you the truth, it’s barely enough to keep the lights on,” claimed College Board president David Coleman.

Among the purchases soon to be offered by the College Board are Time Boosters, the AP Pass, and Point Packages ranging from “Handful of Points” ($4.99) to “Mountain of Points” ($99.99). The decision has come under fire from teachers and students calling the microtransactions “pay-to-win”. This policy might give poorer students a clear disadvantage against their wealthier peers.

“We hear you,” claims Coleman. “That’s why we’re allowing students to still take the test for free!”

A College Board representative confirmed that the free version of the SAT, PSAT, and all AP exams will have unskippable video advertisements between questions. The College Board claims that the advertisements will allow students to take breaks in between questions. How the ads will affect test-taking timing strategy is unknown. However, the Board has confirmed an Ad-Away option for “opportunistic” students ($19.99).

title: Peter Stuyvesant Portrait on Second Floor Removed, Riot Kills 10
author: Alec Tiseo
description: Removal of the Peter Stuyvesant portrait sparks chaos at Stuyvesant High School.
content:
Peter Stuyvesant is known and beloved by all Stuyvesant students (some more than others) as the namesake of this great school. The portrait on the second floor overlooks the half-floor and our school's motto, Pro Scientia Atque Sapientia.

Peter Stuyvesant has also been the catalyst of a cult of worshippers who revere the Dutchman. Outrage followed when a group of students scheming against the cult removed the portrait.

The absence was noticed quickly. Cultists, overtaken by rage, flooded the halls, forcing students to barricade themselves in classrooms and bathrooms.

At the end, 10 students were killed, and 20 injured, including beloved community member Retep Tnasevyuts. The riot ended when Principal Yu declared martial law and rioting cultists were forced into classrooms by weapon-toting members of SU. Principal Yu declines to comment.

title: New Hampshire Real Estate Prices Soar As Billionaires Buy
author: Richard Kiselev
description: After the mayoral election, New Hampshire mansions are snapped up at a record pace.
content:
After Zohran Mamdani won the 2025 mayoral race, New Hampshire real estate prices skyrocketed almost 500% in 30 minutes. A spokesman from Zillow stated that on average, a mansion is being bought every thirty seconds. Mr. S. M. Duck, a self-proclaimed “upper-middle class working man,” just bought a 35.2 floor “cottage”.

“Once that ‘Mazda’ guy takes charge, he’s gonna hurt us working men, he’s a hater,” said Duck.

Mixed reactions: 9-year-old Владимир Ленин said, “We don’t want those capitalist pigs here!” His mother responded, “If they settle here, we can tax them to death!”

Even though New Yorkers and New Hampshirers might not feel the same way, Old Yorkers and Old Hampshirers both welcome the change.

title: Richard’s Recipes: Sadness Soup
author: Richard Kiselev
description: A darkly humorous recipe for the November blues.
content:
Hello readers! It’s November, saying goodbye to October and hello to November. The cold made a nice bowl of Sadness Soup feel even worse!

Sadness Soup (adapted from lovecookingxoxo.com)

Ingredients: 684 Quintillion Molecules of Water (or just taste the polar covalent bonds), 1 Grain of Salt, 100 Bushels of Bay Leaves.

Instructions: Take out a pot, insert 683 quintillion, 999 quadrillion, 999 trillion, 999 billion, 999 million, 999,999 water molecules. Boil with salt and bay leaves. Blend the leaves and strain to get Bay Leaf Juice™. Garnish with the final water molecule. (Don’t) enjoy!
